paper_metadata.title: Dynamic mechanical properties, microstructure evolution and constitutive relations of AlxCoCrFeNi high-entropy alloys: Effects of Al addition and heat treatments

evidence.quote: Al𝑥CoCrFeNi is an interesting high entropy alloy system with crystal structures varying from a fully face-centered cubic (FCC) structure to a fully body-centered cubic (BCC) structure with increasing aluminum content.
